# illumio-core_deny_rules (Data Source)

Represents Illumio Deny Rules

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Deny rules exist only below a rule set, so rule_set_href is required.
# Both ordinary deny rules and override-deny rules are returned; they are
# distinguished by the override attribute.

data "illumio-core_deny_rules" "example" {
  rule_set_href = "/orgs/1/sec_policy/draft/rule_sets/1"
}

output "override_deny_rules" {
  value = [for r in data.illumio-core_deny_rules.example.items : r.href if r.override]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `rule_set_href` (String) URI of the rule set whose deny rules will be returned

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `items` (List of Object) List of Deny Rules in the rule set. Both ordinary deny rules and override-deny rules are returned; they are distinguished by the override attribute (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))
